summary: Iteration-3 tested the new Revenue Targets feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test_iter3.py with 16 tests covering CRUD/RBAC (admin-only POST+DELETE; accounts, site_manager, management all get 403), UPSERT on same {project,period_type,period_key}, project-not-found 404, list filters, site_manager scope isolation, variance series (6 sorted entries, correct shape, math verified against seeded payments/units, null pct on zero-target, YYYY-Qn quarterly key format), and dashboard summary period_targets (monthly + quarterly present with full variance shape, site_manager scoped). ALL 16/16 passed. Frontend: verified Revenue page renders [data-testid='revenue-targets-section'] with kind selector (monthly↔quarterly), Add Target dialog (project/period/amount fields) admin-only, bar chart w/ Target/Received/Accrued series, and rows w/ delete buttons. Dashboard renders [data-testid='period-targets'] with TWO VarianceTile tiles (Month + Quarter), each with Target amount + Received & Accrued variance chips (rose <0, emerald >=0, stone '—' when null).
critical_code_review_comments: RevenueTargetCreate accepts amount without bounds — negative amounts are allowed and will produce negative variance math. Consider Field(ge=0).

period_key is a free-form string in the model; a stray value like '2026-2' (unpadded) or '2026-Q5' would insert successfully and never match variance keys. Add regex validation matching '^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' or '^\d{4}-Q[1-4]$' by period_type.

_resolve_scope returns [] to mean 'user has no visibility' for out-of-scope project_id; list_targets short-circuits with []; but variance() then passes pids=[] which _sum_targets/_compute_period_actuals treat as 'no project filter' → returns global data. Bug: a site_manager who queries variance with an unauthorised project_id will get all-projects numbers. Fix: if scope is empty list, return zeroed series early (or keep the {$in: []} filter).
prior_period_keys steps back using (d - timedelta(days=1)).replace(day=1) which is safe; ok.

Frontend RevenueTargets.jsx suggestPeriods generates keys via new Date(y, m, 1).setMonth(m-1) — DST-safe locally but relies on client tz; if user is in tz where month boundary flips vs UTC this can suggest an off-by-one period_key relative to backend UTC 'current' key. Minor.
